highlights_headline: SkiaSharp restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments and adds Tizen 10 native packages.
highlights_body: Linux applications using the NoDependencies package can again resolve installed system fonts, while Tizen 10 gains current native builds and packaging support.

bullets.detail: Linux applications using the NoDependencies package can again discover installed system fonts through the font manager.
Tizen 10 now receives native builds and packaging produced with its GCC 14.2 toolchain.
